description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_ibase' which extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides database-specific implementations for InterBase/Firebird databases within the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes methods for type mapping and placeholder functions for altering and dropping columns.

classes.name: ADODB2_ibase
classes.description: A database driver class for InterBase/Firebird databases extending the general ADODB_DataDict class, implementing data type mapping and schema modification methods.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal metadata types to SQL data types specific to InterBase/Firebird.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL to alter a column; currently not supported.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL to drop a column; currently not supported.
